name: const unsafe fn write_unaligned < T > (dst : * mut T , src : T)
rule: A pointer obtained by casting a reference is valid for the write while the underlying object is live and no reference is used to access the same memory; reference and raw-pointer accesses must not be interleaved.
api: const unsafe fn write_unaligned < T > (dst : * mut T , src : T)
expression: The supplied DSL cannot express reference-access history or prohibit interleaving over time.
